## Change and reason

Describe the problem or research question and what this change adds or corrects.

## Related work

Link an issue or investigation ID, if applicable.

## Evidence and checks

List sources, checks actually performed, and results. Explain limitations and checks not run.

## Before review

- [ ] This pull request targets `main` from a separate branch or fork.
- [ ] The change follows the agreed scope and contribution guide.
- [ ] Research statements distinguish evidence, source claims, and uncertainty where applicable.
- [ ] No private personal information or third-party material without appropriate rights is included.
- [ ] Applicable documentation and investigation statuses are updated.

Maintainer review and approval are required before merging. Wiki changes are published from the accepted `docs/wiki/` files after merge.
